adjustment_policy.stock_interpretation: Yahoo Finance Close; dividends are excluded. Corporate-action/split handling follows provider Close-series semantics.
adjustment_policy.benchmark_interpretation: NIFTY 50 price-index close; not a total-return index

exclusive_end_semantics: The requested end date is exclusive at the provider; observations on end_date_exclusive are not requested.

diagnostics.session_calendar_source: canonical union of observed provider response dates; no weekday calendar inferred
diagnostics.event_analysis_calendar_source: observed dates with non-missing benchmark close; stock prices are reindexed to this calendar before returns are computed

limitations: Yahoo Finance data can be revised after retrieval.
The snapshot checksum guarantees byte identity, not provider correctness or independent source verification.
Stock Close and benchmark price-index Close are both price-return series; dividends are excluded from both.
Daily data cannot resolve intraday announcement timing.
